type: enum[broadband, narrowband, dual_narrowband, triband_narrowband, quadband_narrowband, light_pollution, solar_narrowband, solar_nd, none]
subtype: enum[luminance, red, green, blue, green/visual, blue/green, near-IR, LRGB set, UV/IR cut, DSLR LPF, DSLR LPF Ha-modified, DSLR LPF replacement, Ha, OIII, SII, Hβ, NII, Ha+OIII, Ha+OIII+Hβ, Ha+OIII+SII, Ha+OIII+SII+Hβ, LPS broadband, UHC, CLS, skyglow, broadband_lp, Ha solar, CaK solar, Solar continuum, Solar ND 3.8, clear] (descriptive subtype within the type)
color: string (hex #rrggbb — badge colour in the UI; seeded per subtype/type by scripts/seed-filter-colors.mjs, which never overwrites an existing value, so per-entry hand overrides are safe)
mono_osc: enum[mono, osc, both] (intended camera type: mono = monochrome only, osc = one-shot colour only, both = either)
bandpass_nm: number | null (total passband width in nm; null for broadband or multi-passband filters)
center_nm: number | null (centre wavelength in nm; null if not a single-line or broadband filter)
fwhm_nm: number | null (full-width half-maximum in nm; null if not specified or multi-passband)

passbands.fwhm_nm: number | null (FWHM in nm; null if not published)

blocking: string | null (out-of-band blocking spec, e.g. 'OD4', 'OD6', '<0.1%', 'UV/IR'; null if not applicable or not specified)
size_options: string (each available size, e.g. '1.25"', '2"', '36mm', 'Built-in', 'Canon EOS APS-C')
thickness_mm: number | null (glass substrate thickness in mm; null if not applicable or not specified)
coatings: string | null (coating description, e.g. 'Ion-assisted deposition', 'Hard sputtered multi-layer AR'; null if not specified)
recommended_for: string (use-case tags, e.g. 'Ha', 'SHO', 'OSC dual-band', 'visual', 'light pollution', 'fast optics f/2–f/3.5')
notes: string | null (free-form notes: compatibility, caveats, accessory requirements, special behaviour)
spcc_name: string | null (exact name as it appears in the Siril SPCC filter database; null if not present in SPCC)
in_spcc: boolean (true if a real transmittance curve for this filter exists in the Siril SPCC database)
astrobin_name: string | null (exact name as it appears in the AstroBin equipment database; null if not listed)
in_astrobin: boolean (true if this filter is listed in the AstroBin equipment database)
status: enum[active, discontinued, standard, software] (active = currently sold; discontinued = no longer in production; standard = photometric/reference standard, not a commercial product; software = synthetic/internal, not a physical filter)
source_url: string | null (canonical URL for specs, e.g. manufacturer product page or spec sheet)
last_verified: ISO-8601 date | null (date the entry was last checked against the source)
